text: Laura McPhie, Co-Chair, Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee, will update the Committee on recent events and initiatives.

Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the Co-Chair, Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee, to send a letter to Kristyn Wong-Tam to convey best wishes and the Committee's appreciation for her leadership, service, and accomplishments towards the advocacy of the Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer issues in the City of Toronto.
